title: Kit Green and Garry Nolan study biological effects on UFO witnesses

tellings.quote: electromagnetic radiation damage, which if you like, you know, Kit Green and Gary Nolan, you know, CIA spooky stuff. They're looking at biological effects of people who've witnessed or encountered UFOs.

plain: Two researchers, Kit Green and Garry Nolan, are said to study the bodily effects on people who have seen or encountered UFOs, including what looks like damage from electromagnetic radiation. Michels mentions it himself, calling it "CIA spooky stuff," as evidence that close encounters can leave physical injuries.
